avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces quinidine levels and therapeutic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; if necessary, monitor quinidine levels closely and adjust dose

avoid_supplements.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit Seed Extract
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases quinidine concentration and toxicity risk
avoid_supplements.action: Completely avoid; significant increase in QT prolongation and arrhythmia risk

avoid_supplements.name: Goldenseal
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4/2D6 inhibition elevates quinidine plasma levels
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue or avoid; monitor ECG and QTc interval if concurrent use unavoidable

avoid_supplements.name: Alkalizing Agents (Sodium Bicarbonate, Calcium Carbonate)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Increased urine pH reduces quinidine renal elimination, elevating serum levels
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid antacids and alkalizing supplements; maintain stable urine pH

caution_supplements.name: Licorice Root
caution_supplements.mechanism: May cause hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia, increasing QT prolongation risk
caution_supplements.action: Monitor potassium and magnesium levels; counsel patient on limitation of intake

caution_supplements.name: Hawthorn
caution_supplements.mechanism: Additive cardiac effects; theoretical risk of enhanced antiarrhythmic action
caution_supplements.action: Use cautiously; monitor heart rate and ECG parameters

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and Grapefruit Juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition significantly increases quinidine bioavailability and toxicity
avoid_foods.action: Completely eliminate from diet; choose alternative fruits (orange, apple)

caution_foods.name: High-Fiber Foods (Bran, Psyllium)
caution_foods.mechanism: May reduce quinidine absorption if taken simultaneously
caution_foods.action: Separate administration by 2+ hours from quinidine dosing

caution_foods.name: Foods High in Potassium Depletion Risk
caution_foods.mechanism: Combined hypokalemia increases risk of QT prolongation and torsades de pointes
caution_foods.action: Monitor dietary potassium; ensure adequate intake; check serum K+ regularly

monitoring_notes: Monitor quinidine serum levels (therapeutic 2-5 mcg/mL), QTc interval, heart rate, and electrolytes (K+, Mg2+) regularly, especially when initiating therapy or adding interacting substances. Assess for signs of toxicity including cinchonism, heart block, or arrhythmia exacerbation.
